updates.title: CVE-2026-62916: Microsoft Entra ID Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. Admins should apply available security updates immediately to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation in their identity infrastructure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-83941: Entra ID Missing Authorization Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A missing authorization flaw in Entra ID enables authorized attackers to escalate privileges over a network. Organizations should prioritize patching to prevent insider threats and unauthorized permission elevation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69524: Active Directory Domain Services Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
updates.summary: A use-after-free vulnerability in Active Directory Domain Services allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely. This critical flaw requires immediate patching to protect on-premises identity infrastructure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69359: Active Directory Domain Services Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A heap-based buffer overflow in Active Directory Domain Services allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges locally. Admins should apply patches to prevent privilege escalation on domain controllers.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69377: Windows Modern Device Management (MDM) Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Missing authorization in Windows MDM allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges locally on managed devices. Admins managing Entra-joined or hybrid-joined devices should patch promptly to prevent local privilege escalation.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Expansion to Copilot + PC Devices for Recall Snapshots
updates.summary: Purview Endpoint DLP is expanding to protect Copilot + PCs by enforcing custom policies on Windows Recall snapshots, preventing capture of windows with restricted sensitivity labels and sensitive information types. Compliance admins can now author DLP policies to integrate with Intune-managed Copilot devices, closing a critical data protection gap in AI-powered snapshot features.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Integration with Entra Global Secure Access for Network-Layer File Filtering
updates.summary: Purview DLP is integrating with Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access to enforce policies at the network layer, enabling organizations to block sensitive files from being shared with untrusted cloud applications including generative AI platforms. This network-level control significantly expands DLP enforcement beyond traditional application boundaries.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Secure Workflow to Bypass Legal Holds and Retention Policies
updates.summary: A new Priority cleanup feature enables admins to create recurring exceptions for deleting items under retention policies or legal holds on Exchange, with built-in multi-approver authorization and full audit trails. This addresses compliance needs for approved exceptions while maintaining governance controls through a dedicated security role.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention Policies for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: DLP policies now work with non-Microsoft applications like Box and Google Workspace using existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and the same classification engine as Microsoft 365. This expansion enables consistent data protection across hybrid multi-cloud environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Policies for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies now extend to non-Microsoft connected apps including Box and Google Workspace, using the same classification and Defender for Cloud Apps connectors as Microsoft 365 locations. Admins can now enforce consistent sensitivity labeling across their entire multi-cloud data estate.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Policy Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Admins can now run auto-labeling policies in simulation mode before enforcement to preview which items would be labeled, review match results, and assess policy readiness without making changes. An Insights tab provides real-time visibility into policy performance and source distribution.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Automated Cleanup of Departed Employee Containers
updates.summary: A new DLM capability enables admins to automatically delete both content and containers (OneDrives and mailboxes) for departed users at scale, reducing manual compliance overhead. This helps organizations maintain clean tenants while ensuring user data is properly disposed of after departure.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Retention Based on Last Accessed Date
updates.summary: Retention labels and policies now support applying retention rules based on when files in OneDrive and SharePoint were last accessed by users, enabling more intelligent data retention tied to actual usage patterns. This helps organizations manage storage costs by retaining only actively-used content while disposing of stale data.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Retention Policies for Microsoft Planner Content
updates.summary: Compliance admins can now create retention policies for Microsoft Planner tasks and plans associated with Microsoft 365 Groups, extending DLM governance to collaborative work management. This closes a gap in managing Planner content lifecycle alongside other Microsoft 365 data.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Sensitive Data Insights and Policy Recommendations
updates.summary: A new analytics capability provides admins insights into sensitive data across OneDrive and SharePoint with AI-powered retention policy recommendations to improve data security and compliance posture. This helps compliance teams identify gaps and strengthen their DLM strategy proactively.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Policy Change Insights with Security Copilot
updates.summary: DLP admins can now use Copilot for Security to summarize and analyze DLP policies, gaining insights into coverage across locations, classifiers, notifications, and more. This AI-assisted capability enables admins to identify policy gaps and align their data protection posture more efficiently.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
updates.summary: DLP is expanding to Microsoft Cowork, allowing admins to enforce a single policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork to protect sensitive AI interactions, block restricted knowledge sources, and prevent sensitive prompts from reaching Bing web search. This unified policy approach simplifies governance of AI collaboration features.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP - Archive File Classification Behavior Change
updates.summary: Archive file classification behavior on Windows endpoints is being updated to align with cloud workload handling, reducing alert noise and improving performance when processing archive files. This consistency improvement simplifies endpoint DLP administration and event management.
